verdict.rationale: Canva offers Connect APIs, an OpenAPI spec for client SDK generation, and a CLI that runs keylessly (verified via npm probe), enabling some automation/CI workflows; the MCP server exists but requires OAuth (401 without auth), and Canva is fundamentally a design/editor product, not built for headless batch execution as a first-class CI use case. missing for 10: evidence of a documented headless/CI mode for the Connect API itself (e.g., service-account or CI-friendly auth flow), independent confirmation of automation pipelines running unattended in CI, and clarity on whether Bulk create/design generation can run without a human editor session.
